verdict.rationale: Skyvern's developer SDK layers Playwright and injects AI into every page interaction. It offers natural-language "act, extract, and validate" commands with selector fallback, and its vision-based element mapping works on unseen sites and adapts when the UI changes. A hands-on report of the agent failing to click a tab and a popup on one site is a reliability caveat, not a contradiction of the capability. Missing for 10: documented signatures for granular click/type primitives on described elements (only page.extract is specified), and independent evidence that actions survive selector or layout changes.
